name: Secret Formula 1g Live Rosin
description:
Lineage: White Fire 43 x Do-Si-Dos

Type: Hybrid - sativa leaning 

Terpenes: D-Limonene, ß-Myrcene, Linalool

Aroma: Diesel, Pine, Earthy

Effects: Body Buzz, Relaxing, Stress-Relieving

This potent blend of White Fire #43 and Do-Si-Dos by Archive Seed Bank is like an anthropomorphic crab's best-kept secret. With notes of pine, earth, and diesel, it might even make a certain squid crack a smile. And the flavor? It's got a little kick of pepper and a dash of citrus, just like the perfect patty recipe. But beware, this indica hybrid isn't for the faint-hearted and it'll hit you like a tidal wave of relaxation. So, if you're ready for a journey to the depths of your own imagination, grab the Secret Formula and experience the fervor!
